turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Ms. Hale. I have twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. Owen has a zero on an essay he wrote himself, and I want it withdrawn today.
I didn't come for thanks. Why did my son find out about this zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
I'm waiting. Why did Owen see that zero on his phone before anyone called me?
We're not here about the weather, Hale. I asked a question, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
I'm waiting, Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, and I'd like to know whether anyone at this school followed its own procedure before putting a zero in front of my son.
